mainSet.name: Mile REPEAT Interval Segment

notes: Maintain consistent pacing throughout all 3 repeats.

cooldown.name: Recovery Cooldown

notes: Bring heart rate down completely
Perform dynamic stretches
Rehydrate immediately

easier.description: Reduce interval volume by running 2 repetitions.

harder.description: Increase interval volume by running 4 repetitions.

coachingNotes: Develop high V02 aerobic capacity via paced rhythm intervals.

Choose a flat, well-lit surface with clean traction for speed work.
